ellie (Design): Quick sync on the trace minimap + stack pane changes. Pushed a mini-proto: https://figma.redwood/trace-minimap-v2. Main concerns: discoverability of span labels, export label mismatch, and compact mode contrast.

claire (Design): The minimap reads nice visually but the tiny rects feel decorative. Keyboard users currently can't jump to spans.

matt (Product): People asked for easier copy/export clarity too 12 some spreadsheets break when header names change.

arjun (Eng-runtime): Current impl is SVG-only, so no native tab stops. We can add a single focus region and let arrow keys move the selection across spans instead of 100+ focusable elements. That keeps DOM small.

sam (Accessibility): Agree with single-focus pattern + logical arrow navigation. Also add aria-live updates announcing: "Span 5 of 18: auth.check, duration 42ms, correlation id 0x7f9" when focus moves. Make sure screen readers get the correlation id verbatim.

ellie (Design): For visual focus, I'd prefer to show a subtle outline only when keyboard navigation is detected, not on mouse hover. We can use a CSS class toggled by a small JS listener.

arjun (Eng-runtime): We'll implement a `keyboard-nav` body class. Works. For performance, we won't render separate DOM buttons for each rect. We'll reuse one element and update its geometry on key events.

nora (Eng-SRE): Another SRE request: the export formats must include correlation_id and span_id fields in JSON/HAR and CSV. Right now CSV uses human labels like "Duration" but the JSON uses snake_case keys. That difference confuses incident tooling.

claire (Design): Proposal: UI shows human labels ("Duration"), export headers use keys ("duration_ms"), and the export modal has a small "Column mapping" table showing both.

matt (Product): Nice. Also persist last-used export format per workspace (CSV vs JSON). Saves clicks.

sam (Accessibility): Ensure the export dropdown is keyboard-navigable and that the mapping table is readable by screen readers (use table semantics, or an accessible list).

ellie (Design): Copy suggestions: change "Download snapshot" to "Save snapshot (PNG)", change export options to "Export events (CSV)" and "Export structured trace (JSON)". Update tooltip copy to use the same human labels as UI.

arjun (Eng-runtime): I'll surface an export metadata payload that includes both `displayName` and `exportKey` for each column so the modal can show both.

nora (Eng-SRE): Small perf note: when a trace has 500 spans, hovering currently triggers many reflows. Avoid computing layout on hover; precompute bounding boxes if possible.

arjun (Eng-runtime): Plan: precompute minimap layout on initial render and only update on resize. Hover will only set a selectedIndex and read precomputed bounding box.

claire (Design): Contrast nit: compact stack mode uses icon-only copy-id button with color #636363 which is below 4.5:1. Suggest #2f2f2f or use a token with higher contrast. Also ensure icon buttons have accessible names (aria-label).

sam (Accessibility): Yes, icon-only must have an aria-label like "Copy correlation id 0x7f9" and also support keyboard activation. If possible show visible text in non-compact mode.

ellie (Design): For small screens, correlation id truncates. Add overflow tooltip that reads the full label and expose a "Copy ID" action inline.

arjun (Eng-runtime): Will add tooltip on overflow and a tiny text button "Open spans" which triggers a filtered search for that correlation id. That helps triage flows.

matt (Product): Can we add analytics events: export.format_selected, minimap.keyboard_navigation, correlation.copy? Product wants metrics to validate adoption.

ellie (Design): I'll draft a short PR checklist: 1) single-focus minimap with arrow keys + aria-live messages, 2) export modal column mapping and persisted last format, 3) contrast tokens updated and icon button aria-labels, 4) overflow tooltip + copy action, 5) performance precompute layout. Tagging @sam and @nora for sign-off.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: trace-ui/minimap-a11y v0.9 -> staging at 2026-03-24T09:45:00Z :rocket:

arjun (Eng-runtime): Picking this up after staging deploy. Will open a PR with component API changes and test plan.

matt (Product): Thanks all 12 let's aim to get a11y sign-off before rolling to prod.

ellie (Design): I'll update Figma and post the checklist in the PR. Thanks!
